name: CodeGeeX
summary: A China-origin IDE coding assistant focused on completion, explanation, and editor-side developer assistance.
overview: CodeGeeX is represented on agentk.it as a current China-origin IDE coding assistant, with evidence anchored to the official product site rather than stale historical repositories. Its role is editor-side assistance: code completion, explanation, translation, and everyday development support for Chinese-language teams. It should not be described as a full autonomous agent, MCP ecosystem, or skill runtime unless current official sources prove those capabilities.

strengths.title: IDE coding assistance
strengths.body: Most useful for code completion, generation, explanation, and everyday developer assistance inside editor workflows.

strengths.title: Chinese developer fit
strengths.body: Relevant for Chinese-language developer teams and users who want domestic AI coding tooling coverage.

strengths.title: Current product evidence only
strengths.body: The page should rely on the live official product surface for current capabilities, not old research repositories that have not been maintained recently.

strengths.title: Assistant rather than orchestration layer
strengths.body: The safest positioning is an IDE assistant category, which avoids overstating unsupported MCP, skills, or autonomous workflow claims.

extensionModel.label: IDE
extensionModel.body: Treat IDE integration as the primary public surface for CodeGeeX recommendations.

extensionModel.label: Official product surface
extensionModel.body: Use the current official CodeGeeX product site as the evidence source for public capability descriptions.

extensionModel.label: MCP
extensionModel.body: No MCP compatibility should be shown unless a current official source or reviewed candidate proves it.

extensionModel.label: Skills
extensionModel.body: Do not map general agent skills to CodeGeeX without source evidence.

recommendedStacks.title: IDE assistant baseline
recommendedStacks.body: Use CodeGeeX pages to collect editor productivity workflows, code-completion notes, and Chinese-language adoption material.

recommendedStacks.title: Signals candidate source
recommendedStacks.body: High-quality Chinese articles about CodeGeeX can feed the translation candidate pool after permission review.

recommendedStacks.title: Domestic AI coding comparison
recommendedStacks.body: Use CodeGeeX as one comparison point against Qwen Code, Kimi Code, and Trae when users evaluate China-origin coding tools.

limitations: Do not overstate MCP, skill, CLI, or autonomous-agent support without official evidence.
Do not use the older THUDM CodeGeeX GitHub repository as current compatibility evidence because it has not been maintained recently.
Installation details should link to official pages instead of being mirrored.
Because the main surface is IDE assistance, compatibility mapping should not imply the same workflow depth as terminal agents.
